name: Heidi and Library (medium)
description: Whereas humans nowadays read fewer and fewer books on paper, book readership among marmots has surged. Heidi has expanded the library and is now serving longer request sequences.
input_specification: Same as the easy version, but the limits have changed: 1 ≤ n , k ≤ 400 000 .
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
